name: Roofing
summary: Replacement and installation — usually alongside siding and fascia, so the whole roofline meets properly.
detail: A roof is rarely the whole job. Where it matters most is at the junctions — a new roof over old fascia is where the next leak comes from, so we deal with the roofline, the soffit and the top course of siding as one piece of work.
alt: An Encino home after a full exterior remodel with new siding, replacement windows and a new roof.
